scope: Root actually viewed exact original/current raw white/cyan/alpha row. Two visible cyan holes in returned collar are an actual alpha defect, not a guessed insignia identity.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: The new inner collar-tab marks were rendered as TRANSPARENT HOLES: white matte makes them look pale, cyan matte shows bright CYAN through both tab centers, and actual alpha has two black internal gaps. Close both internal holes and paint the original pale inner marks as genuinely OPAQUE light material (alpha255), preserving the surrounding opaque black collar and pale tab edging. The whole photo interior, yellow head, grey hair/brows, dark uniform/collar, central button, frame and note must stay opaque; transparency only outside the complete original card. Preserve current correct high uniform/collar, receding hair, independent eyebrows, restrained single closed mouth, pose and compact top note groups, with short broad fitted neck. Do not replace either internal mark with alpha, a cut-out or a window.
